name: command-code-delegate
description: Delegate bounded, well-specified coding to a Command Code CLI worker running DeepSeek: implement, self-verify, fix, and re-verify, then hand the final diff back to the main model for planning and independent review.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate bounded coding to a DeepSeek worker
interface.longDescription: Delegate bounded, well-specified coding to a Command Code CLI worker running DeepSeek: the worker implements, self-verifies, fixes, and re-verifies, then hands the final diff back to the main model for planning and independent review. Suited to simple implementations, repetitive edits, and mechanical transformations under a clearly scoped set of allowed changes.
defaultPrompt: Delegate this bounded task to Command Code and verify the result.
Review the delegated worker's final diff before accepting it.
